description:
· Overall 8+ years of experience on Microsoft SharePoint 2010, SharePoint 2013 / Office 365 and C# .NET 

 
 
 
 
 · Proficient in SharePoint UI/UX development using JavaScript, JQuery, CSS, HTML5, and SP Client Object Model 
 · 5 + years of experience in developing and deploying solutions in Microsoft SharePoint 2010 and 2013 
 · Proficient in SharePoint development using App Model, OAuth, OData, REST, and JSON best-practices 
 · Proficient in designing and implementing SharePoint 2010/2013 Farms (Farm Topology, Infrastructure components, storage, network topology, service applications) 
 · Understanding of SharePoint Search - setup, configuration, tuning, API"s 
 · 3+ Years of experience on designing SharePoint farm topology using SharePoint 2010 and SharePoint 2013 
 · Experience and knowledge of software engineering principles, methods, and techniques 
 · Experience using the SharePoint 2010 and 2013 frameworks as an application development platform 
 · An understanding of SharePoint API's and architecture 
 · Strong leadership, communication (verbal and written), analytical, and problem-solving skills. 
 
 
 
 
 
 

 Bachelors or Masters in Computer Science or equivalent.

 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
